description: Sunset Strip's Hire a clipper (website only). For streamers: one request goes to the 3 listed GTA 6 clippers who fit its language, style and budget, and each replies with a free test short from the streamer's stream. For clippers: how to get hired and how to get listed (18 or over, free, a test short for every request). Returns the steps, the rules, how many clippers are listed now with a few of them (rate, views Sunset Strip checked, hire page) and the links. Never promise earnings.

side.description: streamer (wants a clipper) or clipper (wants to get hired). Omit for both.
